aka: Advertising trailer: The Girl and the Oak

writer.name: 杜尚·武科蒂奇 Dušan Vukotić

trans_title: Advertising trailer: The Girl and the Oak
introduction: The short advertising film THE GIRL AND THE OAK was shot in 1955 on EASTMAN 35mm black and white acetate film.The ZAGREB FILM institution, with the help of the City of Zagreb and the Croatian Audiovisual Center in cooperation with the CROATIAN NATIONAL ARCHIVE - CROATIAN FILM ARCHIVE, restored this film using a digital process in the "KLIK FILM" studio in Zagreb in 2017.
